additional_info.subject: RE: ID0461698-DC/Si-D/FR-[MP/P0 170001104] Screen display error CRM:02889000855
additional_info.body:
Good morning Mr. Delphin,
I am reaching out from the Technical Support Team in regards of ticket
ID0461698.
The ticket was opened for visualization issues of the screensaver on charger
MP/P0 170001104.
I checked the charger remotely and saw the error flag you reported, and I confirm the screensaver was not sent to the charger. I reassigned the screensaver to the charger via the "Screensaver Configuration" on SCB, and now it is visible:
(images are distorted from remote frontend visualization).
Please let me know if further support is required. If no further action is pending from service side, I will proceed to close this ticket.
Looking forward to hearing from you soon.
With kind regards,
Fosco Servidei
Siemens AG
eMobility Customer Service
Technical Support Engineer
SI E EU CS TS
Nonnendammallee 101
13629 Berlin, Germany
mailto:fosco.servidei@siemens.com
www.siemens.com
Important notice: This e-mail and any attachment thereof contain corporate proprietary information. If you have received it by mistake, please notify us immediately by reply e-mail and delete this e-mail and its attachments from your system.
Thank you.
